steps.heading: Split, apply, combine
steps.body: df.groupby('col') splits rows into buckets by the values in col. You then apply an aggregation (.sum(), .mean(), .count()...) to each bucket, and pandas combines the results into one output, one row per unique value in col.

steps.heading: One line, one answer
steps.caption: Select the column you care about before aggregating, otherwise every numeric column gets summed, which is rarely what you want.

steps.heading: Multiple stats at once
steps.body: .agg() lets you compute more than one summary statistic in a single call, instead of chaining separate groupby calls together.

steps.heading: Sum and count together
steps.output:
